title: Interval Test
text: Determine if signal is in specified interval, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Upper limit} sets Upper limit of interval; {Interval closed on right} sets the include upper limit value, {Interval closed on left} sets the include lower limit value, {Lower limit} and {Output data type}. Values come from the instance.
